mapper.select: SELECT LCCL.CREDIT_CATEGORY, LCCL.WITHDRAW_DEADLINE, LCCL.BUSINESS_DEADLINE, LCCL.CREDIT_CONTRACT_LINE_ID, LCCL.CREDIT_CONTRACT_ID, LCCL.RATE, LCCL.RATE_DESC, LCCL.GUARANTEE_TYPE, LCCL.DESCRIPTION, LCCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID, LCCL.CREDIT_TERM, HCL.DOCUMENT_TYPE, HCL.CREDIT_LINE_AMT, CLC.CREDIT_EXPOSURE_AMT, nvl(CLC.WITHDRAW_BALANCE,0) WITHDRAW_BALANCE, nvl(HCL.CREDIT_LINE_AMT,0)- nvl(CLC.CREDIT_EXPOSURE_AMT,0) CREDIT_AVAILABLE_AMT, nvl(CLC.TOTAL_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT,0) TOTAL_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT, nvl(CLC.LIMIT_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT,0) LIMIT_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT, HCL.VALID_FROM, HCL.VALID_TO, HCL.CANCEL_FLAG, HCL.SOURCE_CREDIT_LINE_ID, nvl((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LON_CONTRACT LC JOIN LON_CONTRACT_WITHDRAW LCW ON LC.CONTRACT_ID=LCW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE LC.RELE_CREDIT_FLAG='Y' AND LCW.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND LC.CREDIT_LINE_ID=LCCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID),0) WITHDRAW_COUNT, 'N' SOURCE_CREDIT_FLAG, SHCL.CANCEL_FLAG SOURCE_CANCEL_FLAG, v1.meaning credit_category_n, v2.meaning guarantee_type_n, hdt.description document_type_n FROM LON_CREDIT_CONTRACT_LINE LCCL JOIN HLS_CREDIT_LINE HCL ON HCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID= LCCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID JOIN LON_CREDIT_LINE_CALC CLC ON CLC.CREDIT_LINE_ID=LCCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID LEFT JOIN HLS_CREDIT_LINE SHCL ON SHCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID=HCL.SOURCE_CREDIT_LINE_ID left join sys_code_value_b_v v1 on v1.code= 'LON.CREDIT_CATEGORY' and v1.code_value = LCCL.CREDIT_CATEGORY left join sys_code_value_b_v v2 on v2.code= 'LON.GUARANTEE_TYPE' and v2.code_value = LCCL.GUARANTEE_TYPE left join hls_document_type hdt on hdt.document_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE' and hdt.business_type = 'FINANCING_LOAN' and hdt.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hdt.document_type = HCL.DOCUMENT_TYPE WHERE LCCL.CREDIT_CONTRACT_ID=#{creditContractId}

SELECT nvl(SUM(HCL.CREDIT_LINE_AMT),0) CREDIT_LINE_AMT_SUM FROM LON_CREDIT_CONTRACT_LINE LCCL JOIN HLS_CREDIT_LINE HCL ON HCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID= LCCL.CREDIT_LINE_ID WHERE LCCL.CREDIT_CONTRACT_ID=#{creditContractId}
